title: pterocypsela laciniata
intro: Pterocypsela laciniata, commonly known as Chinese cistanthe, is a plant species in the family Lythraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which offer health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, potentially aiding in the treatment of various conditions.
